title: The structural and transcriptional basis of carboxylesterase-mediated lambda-cyhalothrin resistance in Spodoptera litura.
authors: Li, Jun; Huang, Xiaodan; Deng, Mengqing; Chen, Jiemeng; Zhou, Linjie; Xu, Xiyue; Zhao, Xinyu; Peng, Rui; Yang, Zhiming; Lu, Kai
one_liner_zh: 该文研究斜纹夜蛾羧酸酯酶代谢抗药性机制，涉及分子对接和转录因子HNF4调控，但核心是酶-底物互作而非蛋白质-DNA结合建模，仅转录因子调控表达为边缘关联。
abstract: Pyrethroid resistance in Lepidopteran pests poses a serious threat to sustainable pest management. Although carboxylesterases (COEs) contribute to metabolic resistance, their precise functional roles and regulation remain obscure. Here, a lambda-cyhalothrin-resistant strain of the tobacco cutworm Spodoptera litura (93.29-fold resistance) showed significantly increased COE activity. Synergism assays using triphenyl phosphate confirmed COE involvement, increasing lambda-cyhalothrin toxicity with synergistic ratios of 2.26 and 2.33 in susceptible and resistant strains. Three COE genes (COE052, COE054, and COE066) were markedly overexpressed in the resistant strain, with midgut expression upregulated by 140.63-, 102.60-, and 99.98-fold, respectively. RNA interference revealed that COE052 and COE066 are essential for resistance, while COE054 knockdown had no effect, likely due to compensatory overexpression of the other two COEs. Heterologous expression in bacteria demonstrated that all three COEs confer increased lambda-cyhalothrin tolerance by 3.13-, 2.26-, and 3.29-fold and exhibit antioxidant activity. In vitro metabolism assays confirmed their capacity to degrade lambda-cyhalothrin, with COE066 displaying the highest metabolic efficiency (47.20%). Molecular docking and mutagenesis identified Asn446 and His447 in COE066 as key residues for lambda-cyhalothrin binding, metabolism, and antioxidant function. His447 was particularly critical: its mutation decreased binding free energy from -34.96 to 3.28 kcal mol(-1), reduced metabolic efficiency from 51.10% to 14.39%, and significantly impaired antioxidant activity. Furthermore, the transcription factor HNF4 was found to regulate the expression of all three COEs, establishing an HNF4-COE regulatory axis underlying lambda-cyhalothrin resistance. This study elucidates the mechanism of COE-mediated pyrethroid resistance and highlights potential targets for resistance management.
abstract_zh: 鳞翅目害虫对拟除虫菊酯的抗性对可持续害虫管理构成严重威胁。尽管羧酸酯酶（COEs）参与代谢抗性，但其精确的功能角色和调控机制仍不清楚。本研究中，一种对λ-氯氟氰菊酯抗性的斜纹夜蛾（Spodoptera litura）品系（抗性倍数为93.29倍）表现出显著升高的COE活性。使用三苯基磷酸酯的增效测定确认了COE的参与，其在敏感和抗性品系中将λ-氯氟氰菊酯的毒性分别提高了2.26倍和2.33倍的增效比。三个COE基因（COE052、COE054和COE066）在抗性品系中显著过表达，其中中肠表达分别上调了140.63倍、102.60倍和99.98倍。RNA干扰揭示COE052和COE066对抗性至关重要，而COE054的敲低无影响，这可能是由于其他两个COE的补偿性过表达所致。细菌中的异源表达表明，所有三个COE均赋予λ-氯氟氰菊酯耐受性增加3.13倍、2.26倍和3.29倍，并表现出抗氧化活性。体外代谢测定确认了它们降解λ-氯氟氰菊酯的能力，其中COE066显示出最高的代谢效率（47.20%）。分子对接和突变分析鉴定出COE066中的Asn446和His447是λ-氯氟氰菊酯结合、代谢和抗氧化功能的关键残基。His447尤为关键：其突变使结合自由能从-34.96降至3.28 kcal mol(-1)，代谢效率从51.10%降至14.39%，并显著损害抗氧化活性。此外，转录因子HNF4被发现调控所有三个COE的表达，建立了HNF4-COE调控轴，该轴是λ-氯氟氰菊酯抗性的基础。本研究阐明了COE介导的拟除虫菊酯抗性机制，并突出了抗性管理的潜在靶点。
